video_title: From Nigeria to the NBA: Zuby Ejiofor’s Incredible Journey | St. John’s → Hawks | 23rd Pick | EP5

quotes.speaker: Zuby Ejiofor
quotes.summary_phrase: Zuby Ejiofor on the emotional weight of NBA draft day
quotes.quote: Every emotion possible to be honest. It's excitement, it's nerves. The draft starts at 7:00 and we're hoping for a really special day to end it.

quotes.speaker: Andy Philachack
quotes.summary_phrase: Andy Philachack on the anxiety surrounding Zuby Ejiofor's draft
quotes.excerpt: I haven't slept in like a week probably because I'm so anxious, nervous, anxiety.
quotes.quote: I haven't slept in like a week probably because I'm so anxious, nervous, anxiety.

quotes.speaker: Sandra Ejiofor
quotes.summary_phrase: Sandra Ejiofor on Zuby Ejiofor's lack of basketball background
quotes.excerpt: He has little or no idea about basketball.
quotes.quote: He has little or no idea about basketball. We raised them so disciplined that they turned to be respectful, fearful, humble.

quotes.speaker: Andy Philachack
quotes.summary_phrase: Andy Philachack on discovering Zuby Ejiofor's raw athletic potential
quotes.excerpt: This kid can run, he never stopped moving.
quotes.quote: This kid can run, he never stopped moving. He's just looping back and forth, but couldn't catch the ball, couldn't make a shot, couldn't do anything. But I can see the physical traits, what he could become.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy on Zuby Ejiofor's mental approach to the game
quotes.excerpt: It wasn't his skill set, it was more so his mental, his mentality, the want to win.
quotes.quote: It wasn't his skill set, it was more so his mental, his mentality, the want to win.

quotes.speaker: Andy Philachack
quotes.summary_phrase: Andy Philachack on the dedication required for Zuby Ejiofor's development
quotes.excerpt: We would drive every weekend to Houston on Friday, practice with the team and drive back.
quotes.quote: We would drive every weekend to Houston on Friday, practice with the team and drive back on Sunday. We did that for three years, just putting the work in.

quotes.speaker: Zuby Ejiofor
quotes.summary_phrase: Zuby Ejiofor on the challenges of his time at Kansas
quotes.excerpt: Being a high-level competitor and not being able to get minutes on the floor, kind of sucked.
quotes.quote: Being a high-level competitor and not being able to get minutes on the floor, kind of sucked for me.

quotes.speaker: Andy Philachack
quotes.summary_phrase: Andy Philachack on the urgency of Zuby Ejiofor's career development
quotes.excerpt: Your window the opportunity to play basketball is closing. You had your funding in Kansas, now is work time.
quotes.quote: Your window the opportunity to play basketball is closing. You had your funding in Kansas, now is work time. You hear the work.

quotes.speaker: Zuby Ejiofor
quotes.summary_phrase: Zuby Ejiofor on his desired impact in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I want to leave in the NBA someone who comes in, shows up each and every night.
quotes.quote: I want to leave in the NBA someone who comes in, shows up each and every night, still play with high energy and making a positive impact in whatever fashion. A guy that players and coaches could rely on and just preach winning, bring a winning attitude.

quotes.speaker: Zuby Ejiofor
quotes.summary_phrase: Zuby Ejiofor on the emotional realization of being drafted
quotes.excerpt: I heard the commissioner say 23rd pick and then my name be called and instant tears.
quotes.quote: I heard the commissioner say 23rd pick and then my name be called and instant tears, just reminiscing on everything it took to get to this moment. The tears literally started gushing instantly. I tried to hold it in, but I couldn't. But yeah, there was no thoughts, it was just living in the moment.
